title: Committee of Supply – Head L (Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head L (Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources)

sections.label: Man-made island lifespan estimate
sections.summary: The man-made island was meant to meet needs until 2045, but recent estimates suggest a reduction of a full decade.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The man-made island was supposed to meet our needs until 2045, but recent estimates indicate that it could be reduced by a full decade.

sections.label: YouGov survey on disposable plastics
sections.summary: A YouGov survey found 95% of Singapore consumers acknowledge environmental, health and pollution issues from excessive disposable plastic use.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: A survey by global public opinion and data company YouGov found that 95% of Singapore's consumers acknowledge the environmental, health and pollution issues caused by excessive use of disposable plastics.

sections.label: Companies join Plastic ACTion initiative
sections.summary: As of January this year, nine companies teamed up to relook their plastic use under WWF's Plastic ACTion initiative.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: As of January this year, nine companies, including large hotel chains and popular food establishments, have teamed up to relook their plastic use under the Plastic ACTion initiative by the World Wide Fund for Nature.

sections.label: Reusable takeaway container service launch
sections.summary: In January this year, a new Singapore service partnered F&B outlets to replace disposable takeaway containers and cutlery with reusables.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In January this year, a new service was launched in Singapore, partnering F&B outlets to switch disposable containers and cutlery for takeaways with reusables made of stainless steel or glass.

sections.label: NUS research on water-saving incentives
sections.summary: NUS research shows normative incentives work as well as economic ones for saving water, with campaign messages motivating savings of 4.9 litres daily per person.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Research by the National University of Singapore (NUS) has shown that when it comes to saving water, normative incentives work as well as economic ones.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Hence, campaign messages can motivate households to save as much as 4.9 litres a day per person, or about 3% of demand.

sections.label: Singapore food waste statistics
sections.summary: NEA information states Singaporeans generated about 810,000 tonnes of food waste in 2017, with only 16% recycled and a 40% rise over 10 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: According to information from the National Environment Agency (NEA) and other related websites, Singaporeans generated about 810,000 tonnes of food waste in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Food waste constitutes about 10% of the total waste generated, but only 16% is recycled.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Over the past 10 years, NEA noted that food waste generated in Singapore has increased by about 40% and is projected to increase with our growing population and economic activities.

sections.label: Food waste recycling policies
sections.summary: The passage asks the Minister to update on food waste in Singapore and on policies to raise recycling of 810,000 tonnes of yearly food waste.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Can I ask the Minister to update on the current state of food waste in Singapore?

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: What policies and initiatives does the Ministry have in mind to increase the recycling rate of the 810,000 tonnes of food waste generated every year?

sections.label: Cellphone recycling and e-waste
sections.summary: The passage cites a report linking cellphone recycling to reduced mining in gorilla habitat and notes an Extended Producer Responsibility approach for e-waste by 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The report also stressed that, "Participating in cellphone recycling programmes helps reduce the demand for mining in gorilla habitat".

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I have spoken up about the recycling of e-waste for several years and I am glad that we are making progress and will be introducing the Extended Producer Responsibility approach to managing e-waste by 2021.

sections.label: Packaging waste reporting mandate
sections.summary: The passage states packaging waste needs addressing and that businesses will be mandated to report packaging type, amount and reduction plans, brought forward to 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Part of the problem is packaging waste, and this clearly needs to be addressed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I am glad that we will mandate that businesses report on the type and amount of packaging, including plastics, they put on the market and their plans for reduction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It is even better news that this has been brought forward from 2021 to 2020, next year.

sections.label: Disposables ban at hawker centres
sections.summary: The passage states new hawker centres disallow disposables for dining in and asks whether the ban will extend to all hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: For new hawker centres, we have already disallowed the use of disposables for dining in.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Since 2019 has been designated as the year towards Zero Waste in Singapore, will the Minister consider extending the ban on the use of disposables for dining in to all hawker centres?

sections.label: Zero Waste Master Plan targets
sections.summary: The passage states the Zero Waste Master Plan will be launched towards the end of this year and targets food waste, e-waste and packaging waste.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Chairman, it is great to hear that the Zero Waste Master Plan will be launched towards the end of this year and will specifically target the problem area of food waste, e-waste and packaging waste.

sections.label: Singapore domestic recycling rate
sections.summary: The passage states the domestic recycling rate is stuck at 21%, citing a survey on plastic use and recycling knowledge.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: On recycling, our domestic recycling rate has been stuck at 21%.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: A survey by the Singapore Environment Council (SEC) found that we use at least 1.76 billion plastic items a year, of which less than 20% is recycled.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: SEC also reported that seven in 10 people do not know what plastics to recycle.

sections.label: MEWR online retailer packaging reduction
sections.summary: MEWR will work with online retailers to minimise packaging and may legislate or impose a packaging tax to compel reduction.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: On this front, MEWR will have to work closely with online retailers to minimise packaging and may well have to legislate or impose a packaging tax to compel reduction.

sections.label: Pharmacist home visits drug savings
sections.summary: A hospital estimated drug wastage at $663 per patient, and pharmacist visits could save at least $329,000 yearly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: One local hospital estimated the drug wastage cost detected during pharmacists' home visits at $663 per patient.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Hypothetically speaking, if one pharmacist is given the resource to visit 10 patients a week over a one-year period to perform full reconciliation, the total potential drug savings can amount to at least $329,000, with $176,000 and $153,000 of savings in subsidies and out-of-pocket savings respectively.

sections.label: Patient medication disposal survey results
sections.summary: The survey showed 75.4% of patients bin medication waste, 5% flush it, and 85.7% do not know correct disposal.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The patient survey mentioned above showed that 75.4% of patients surveyed throw their medication waste into a trash bin, with 5% throwing into the sink or flushing down the toilet, and 85.7% of patients surveyed are not aware of the correct method for medication disposal.

sections.label: Pharmacist proposes funding and drug take-back
sections.summary: A pharmacist volunteer proposes MOH fund pharmaceutical services and cites Canada and US drug take-back services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: From my experience as a pharmacist volunteer at a local hospice, it is not uncommon to see controlled drugs in bags of medication waste.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I propose that the Ministry of Health (MOH) consider funding to support pharmaceutical services, such as medication reviews and reconciliation, as well as deprescribing efforts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Regarding solutions to safe disposal, we can look to countries like Canada and the United States (US) which have special government services offering to take back and dispose of unused and expired drugs.

sections.label: Drug take-back campaigns and limited collections
sections.summary: MOH, HSA, MHA and NEA should support drug take-back campaigns, with new prescriptions limited to two to four weeks' supply.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: MOH, the Health Sciences Authority (HSA), the Ministry of Home Affairs and NEA should make efforts to support such drug take-back campaigns through collaboration with hospitals and community pharmacies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This will provide a channel for patients to return and safely dispose of unwanted drugs, particularly cytotoxic drugs, antibiotics and substances of abuse.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: For example, when prescribed with new medications, collections should be limited to two to four weeks' worth of supply.

sections.label: Funding deliveries and self-collection lockers
sections.summary: MOH may consider funding home deliveries or lockers to encourage instalment collections instead of large supplies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: MOH may like to consider funding charges for home deliveries or self-collection lockers to encourage instalment collections instead of collecting large supplies at one go.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This may turn out to be more cost-effective in the long run.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It is my sincere hope that my suggestions to reduce medication waste and to improve cost effectiveness of our healthcare system be deliberated with all due consideration.

sections.label: Semakau Landfill space estimate discrepancy
sections.summary: A brochure shows Semakau Landfill meeting Singapore's needs beyond 2045, while today's estimate is 2035, ten years earlier.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: To his shock, he saw that in this brochure, it shows that Semakau Landfill is expected to meet Singapore's needs for landfill space beyond the year 2045 but that today's estimate is 2035, that is, 10 years ahead.

sections.label: Semakau Landfill after 2035
sections.summary: The speaker asks what happens after 2035 when the landfill is filled, and notes the first space cost $610,0000 and four years.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: Can the Minister share what happens after 2035 when the landfill is filled?

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: This brochure also showed that the first space of Semakau Landfill cost $610,0000 and four years to complete.

sections.label: E-waste recycling and producer responsibility
sections.summary: Only 6% of an estimated 30,000 tonnes of e-waste is recycled, and in two years a framework based on Extended Producer Responsibility will exist.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: E‐waste management is another important aspect as only 6% of our estimated 30,000 tonnes of e‐waste go into recycling.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: Two years from now, we will have a management framework based on the Extended Producer Responsibility where, among other things, producers have to ensure that their products are properly recycled at the end of life.

sections.label: Electrifying public bus fleet
sections.summary: Public service vehicles such as nearly 6,000 public buses could be electrified, and MOT plans to convert the public bus fleet to clean energy by 2040.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: However, public service vehicles, such as our nearly 6,000 public buses, could be electrified.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: We just heard that MOT has a plan to convert the public bus fleet to clean energy by 2040.

sections.label: Quartz and marble plaques contractor
sections.summary: The contractor will bear costs, NEA withheld payments and will claim price differences, but no contractor explanation has been given for 8,600 quartz plaques out of 20,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The Minister has told me in his PQ answer that the contractor will bear the costs required to make good on what should have been delivered, that NEA has withheld payments to the contractor, and NEA will also be claiming against the contractor for any difference in price between the quartz and marble plaques.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: However, to date, we have not yet been told any explanation given by the contractor for their supply of the 8,600 quartz plaques out of the 20,000 total number of plaques.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: So, it is more than one third of the contracted quantity.

sections.label: Singapore Hawker Culture UNESCO nomination
sections.summary: The speaker asks how Singapore's nomination of its Hawker Culture for UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity is progressing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: How is our nomination of Singapore’s Hawker Culture for the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity progressing?

sections.label: Mentorship and Incubation Stall Programmes
sections.summary: The Ministry is asked to share a progress report on its mentorship and Incubation Stall Programmes that train cooks to manage a hawker stall.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Will the Ministry share a progress report on its mentorship programme and Incubation Stall Programme which train interested cooks and teach them how to manage a hawker stall?

sections.label: Hawker centre rent and cost measures
sections.summary: Existing centres had reserve rent removed and subletting disallowed, new centre tenders favour lower costs, and Productive Hawker Centre grants were extended two years from January 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: For existing centres, the reserve rent has been removed as well as subletting and assignment have been disallowed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: For new centres, the tender evaluation favour tenderers who offer lower total rental and operating costs and prohibit any increases in rentals or operating costs for the duration of the tenancy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: In addition, I am glad that the Productive Hawker Centre grants have been extended for two years with effect from January 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: This shall help the SEHC stallholders manage their costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: This means that the stallholders at the hawker centres can enjoy a 50% reduction in their centralised dishwashing costs for the first year and 30% for the second year.

sections.label: Operator tenancy termination and deposits
sections.summary: Operators will no longer need a two-month notice period to terminate tenancies or security deposits exceeding two months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: Operators will also now not require a notice period of two months to terminate their tenancies or require security deposits exceeding two months.

sections.label: Global Food Security Index rating
sections.summary: The Economist Intelligence Unit Global Food Security Index rates Singapore as the most food secure in the world.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Even the Economist Intelligence Unit Global Food Security Index seems to agree.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: We are rated as the most food secure in the world.

sections.label: Food spending and import dependence
sections.summary: Singapore spends the lowest on food as a share of household expenditure after the US and imports nearly 90% of what it eats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Globally, we spend the lowest on food as a percentage of our household expenditure after the US.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: We import nearly 90% of what we eat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: That makes us extremely susceptible to trade and supply chain disruptions from climate and political events.

sections.label: Sector share of GDP
sections.summary: It no longer has a category of its own and accounts for less than 0.02% of GDP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Today, it no longer has a category of its own and accounts for less than 0.02% of our GDP.

sections.label: FairPrice support for local producers
sections.summary: FairPrice builds an ecosystem supporting local producers and carries close to 5,000 locally-produced items, about 20% of its total sales.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Over the years, FairPrice has made it a critical mission to build an ecosystem to support local producers beyond moderating costs of food.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: I understand that FairPrice carries close to 5,000 locally-produced items, accounting for about 20% of its total sales.

sections.label: Food safety and Singapore Food Agency
sections.summary: The passage asks how the Ministry ensures food safety, cold chain and low compliance costs, and notes SFA will combine AVA, NEA and HSA food functions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: How does the Ministry ensure that food safety is maintained throughout the supply chain and that effective cold chain is in place?

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: How does it also ensure they monitor compliance cost keenly to minimise regulatory costs?

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The formation of the Singapore Food Agency (SFA) will bring together the food-related functions of the Agri-Food and Veterinary Authority (AVA), NEA and HSA.

sections.label: Singapore water demand and PUB initiatives
sections.summary: A 2015 study found Singapore likely water-stressed in 2040, and the passage asks what initiatives will lower household water demand to 130 litres per capita daily by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin (Sembawang)
sentences.text: A study by the Water Resources Institute in 2015 found that Singapore was a country most likely to be water-stressed in 2040, amid climate change and increasing water demand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Even so, a recent focus group study by PUB and the feedback unit Reaching Everyone for Active Citizenry @ Home (REACH) observed that younger Singaporeans and Permanent Residents appear to be less concerned about the sustainability of Singapore's water supply.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Given that being able to meet our country's growing water demand is critical to Singapore's future developments, what initiatives will the Ministry and PUB introduce to help households achieve the target of lowering household water demand to 130 litres per capita per day by 2030?

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The non-domestic sector is expected to contribute significantly to our water demand growth.

sections.label: Singapore land, resources and Water Agreements
sections.summary: Singapore has little land and no natural resources and is water-stressed, and the 1961 and 1962 Water Agreements were guaranteed in the Separation Agreement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have too little land to cultivate food meaningfully, no natural resources to enrich ourselves and remain one of the most water-stressed countries in the world.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We must never forget that the 1961 and 1962 Water Agreements ensured a supply of water from Johor to meet Singapore's needs, and were so sacrosanct that they were guaranteed by both Singapore and Malaysia in the Separation Agreement.

sections.label: PUB research and development funding
sections.summary: The Research, Innovation and Enterprise Council allocated PUB $200 million for R&D, including breakthrough technologies such as desalinated water using one kWh/m3.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The Research, Innovation and Enterprise Council (RIEC) allocated PUB $200 million for R&D, which includes pursuing breakthrough technologies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We will pose what we call "Big Hairy Audacious Goals" to scientists, such as producing desalinated water with energy use of one kWh/m3 (kilo Watt hour per metre cube) at the systems level.

sections.label: Jobs and economic value-add results
sections.summary: Investments in the past decade created some 14,400 jobs and over $2.2 billion annual value-add, exceeding 2006 targets of 11,000 jobs and $1.5 billion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Our investments in the past decade have created some 14,400 good jobs and economic value-add of over $2.2 billion annually, far more than our 2006 target of 11,000 jobs and $1.5 billion value-add.

sections.label: Stamford flood resilience projects
sections.summary: The Stamford Diversion Canal and Stamford Detention Tank were completed last year to enhance flood resilience.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: To enhance our flood resilience, we completed the Stamford Diversion Canal and Stamford Detention Tank last year.

sections.label: Energy efficiency and floating solar
sections.summary: The Government is prepared to spend more than $1 billion in tax revenues over five years to help companies become more energy-efficient, and PUB is studying floating solar PV systems at four reservoirs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The Government is prepared to spend more than $1 billion to be collected over the next five years in tax revenues to help companies become more energy-efficient.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: PUB is studying the deployment of floating solar Photo Voltaic (PV) systems at four reservoirs – Bedok, Lower Seletar, Upper Peirce and Tengeh.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Together, these systems potentially have a capacity to power 40,000 four-room HDB households each year – about half the size of Tampines.

sections.label: Desalination plants completion
sections.summary: When Marina East and Jurong Island Desalination Plants are completed next year, Singapore will have five desalination plants in total.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: When Marina East and Jurong Island Desalination Plants are completed next year, we will have a total of five desalination plants.

sections.label: Default Notice to Tuaspring
sections.summary: PUB issued a Default Notice to Tuaspring Pte Ltd, the Hyflux subsidiary owning and operating the Tuaspring Integrated Water and Power Plant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Members would be aware that, earlier this week, PUB issued a Default Notice to Tuaspring Pte Ltd (TPL), the Hyflux subsidiary that owns and operates the Tuaspring Integrated Water and Power Plant.

sections.label: Hoya Electronics NEWater reduction
sections.summary: Hoya Electronics Singapore reduced its NEWater consumption by 75%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: One beneficiary is Hoya Electronics Singapore, which reduced its NEWater consumption by 75%.

sections.label: Year Towards Zero Waste
sections.summary: Singapore designated 2019 as the Year Towards Zero Waste.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Singapore designated 2019 as the Year Towards Zero Waste.

sections.label: Closing waste loop vision
sections.summary: The vision is to close the waste loop through circular economy approaches and turn trash into treasure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Our vision is to close the waste loop through circular economy approaches and turn trash into treasure.

sections.label: NEA waste loop R&D funding
sections.summary: NEA set aside $45 million under the Closing the Waste Loop R&D Initiative to fund circular economy projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: NEA set aside $45 million under the “Closing the Waste Loop” R&D Initiative to fund projects adopting circular economy approaches.

sections.label: Solar panel recycling collaboration
sections.summary: Singapore Polytechnic developed a solar panel recycling process and signed a collaboration with SembCorp Industries for a pilot plant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Take Singapore Polytechnic, which after developing a recycling process for solar panels that can potentially recover up to 90% of useful materials, signed a memorandum of collaboration with SembCorp Industries to develop a pilot recycling plant for used PV panels.

sections.label: Multi-Storey Recycling Facility
sections.summary: JTC, in consultation with NEA, is developing the Multi-Storey Recycling Facility, expected ready in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: JTC, in consultation with NEA, is developing the Multi-Storey Recycling Facility which is expected to be ready in 2021.

sections.label: Treated ash draft standards
sections.summary: NEA is leading the effort and has developed draft standards for using treated ash, such as for building roads.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: NEA is leading the effort and has developed draft standards for the use of treated ash, such as for building roads.

sections.label: Climate change crop yield decline
sections.summary: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change estimates crop yield declines of up to 25% by 2050 due to climate change.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change estimates widespread declines in crop yields of up to 25% by 2050 due to climate change.

sections.label: Local food production target
sections.summary: Local production will reduce reliance on imports and buffer overseas supply disruptions, aiming to produce 30% of Singapore's nutritional needs by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Local production will reduce our reliance on imports and buffer the impact of overseas supply disruptions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: That is, to locally produce 30% of Singapore's nutritional needs by 2030 – "30% by 30" or "30 by 30 vision".

sections.label: Integrated space pilot at former school
sections.summary: Farms can testbed food-growing technologies, and SLA, MOH and ECDA are piloting repurposing former Henderson Secondary School into an urban farm, childcare centre, nursing home and dialysis centre.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Such farms can also be used to testbed innovative technologies for growing food.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are working with the Singapore Land Authority, MOH and the Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) to pilot this concept, repurposing the former Henderson Secondary School into an integrated space comprising an urban farm, a childcare centre, a nursing home and a dialysis centre.

sections.label: Barramundi Asia fish vaccination technology
sections.summary: Using technology, Barramundi Asia can vaccinate 9,000 fish in one hour, compared to just 600 manually.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Using technology, Barramundi Asia can vaccinate 9,000 fish in one hour, compared to just 600 manually.

sections.label: RIEC funding for Singapore Food Story
sections.summary: RIEC has set aside $144 million to write the Singapore Food Story.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: RIEC has also set aside $144 million for us to write the Singapore Food Story.

sections.label: SkillsFuture programmes with polytechnics
sections.summary: They worked with Republic Polytechnic and Temasek Polytechnic to launch SkillsFuture Earn-&-Learn Programmes for fresh ITE graduates, leading to diplomas in Urban Agricultural Technology and Aquaculture.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: To this end, we have worked with Republic Polytechnic and Temasek Polytechnic to launch SkillsFuture Earn-&-Learn Programmes (ELP) for fresh Institute of Technical Education (ITE) graduates, leading to diplomas in Urban Agricultural Technology and Aquaculture.

sections.label: Government RIE 2020 spending
sections.summary: The Government will spend almost $400 million under RIE 2020 towards research and innovation in water, circular economy, climate change and food.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In total, the Government will spend almost $400 million under Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE) 2020 towards research and innovation in water, circular economy and climate change and food.

sections.label: Co-digestion at Tuas Nexus
sections.summary: Co-digestion technology will be scaled up and adopted for the new Tuas Nexus, operational in 2025.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This co-digestion technology illustrates the potential in exploiting synergies in the food-water-energy-waste nexus.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are preparing to scale this technology up and adopt it for the new Tuas Nexus, which will be operational in 2025.

sections.label: Building a sustainable Singapore
sections.summary: Plans for water, waste and food sectors face a long road, but Singapore will persevere in building sustainably.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Likewise, the vision of a reservoir in the heart of the city was only realised many years after our Founding Prime Minister mooted the idea.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have ambitious plans for our water, waste and food sectors, but the road ahead is long and winding.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We will persevere, for we are not done building a sustainable Singapore.

sections.label: Circular economy and Zero Waste Master Plan
sections.summary: A circular economy approach will conserve resources, and the inaugural Zero Waste Master Plan will be released this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We will adopt a circular economy approach to conserve resources for a sustainable Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We will release the inaugural Zero Waste Master Plan later this year.

sections.label: Resource Sustainability Bill
sections.summary: A Resource Sustainability Bill will be introduced this year to cover management of three priority waste streams.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: To effect our plans, we will be introducing the Resource Sustainability Bill this year to cover management of the three priority waste streams.

sections.label: Framework effective in 2021
sections.summary: Mr Louis Ng and Miss Cheng Li Hui asked for details of the framework, which comes into effect in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Mr Louis Ng and Miss Cheng Li Hui asked for details of the framework, which will come into effect in 2021.

sections.label: E-waste coverage in Singapore
sections.summary: Almost 90% of e-waste in Singapore will be covered.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Almost 90% of e-waste in Singapore will be covered.

sections.label: NEA collection targets for PRO
sections.summary: NEA will impose collection targets on the PRO, but penalties for missing targets will not be enforced in the first three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: NEA will impose collection targets on the PRO.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: But as a transitional measure, penalties for missing collection targets will not be enforced in the first three years.

sections.label: New e-waste recycling requirements
sections.summary: The framework will include new recycling requirements so all collected e-waste is properly treated to recover resources and remove harmful substances.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The framework will include new recycling requirements to ensure that all collected e-waste is properly treated to facilitate the recovery of resources, such as gold, and the removal of harmful substances.

sections.label: Packaging waste share of domestic waste
sections.summary: Packaging waste comprised one-third of domestic waste disposed of in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Packaging waste comprised one-third of domestic waste disposed of in 2018.

sections.label: Exemption for micro and small enterprises
sections.summary: Micro and small enterprises with an annual turnover of $10 million or less will be exempted for a start.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For a start, we will exempt micro and small enterprises with an annual turnover of $10 million or less.

sections.label: Mandatory reporting for packaging waste EPR
sections.summary: Mandatory reporting is the first step in the plan to introduce an EPR framework for managing packaging waste, including plastics, by 2025.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Mandatory reporting is the first step in our plan to introduce an EPR framework for managing packaging waste, including plastics, by 2025.

sections.label: Food waste segregation for large premises
sections.summary: From 2024, commercial and industrial premises generating large amounts of food waste must segregate it for treatment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: From 2024, we will require commercial and industrial premises that generate large amounts of food waste to segregate it for treatment.

sections.label: Hotel and mall waste reporting
sections.summary: Since 2014, owners and managers of large hotels and malls have reported general waste data and waste reduction plans to NEA.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Since 2014, owners and managers of large hotels and malls have been reporting their general waste data and waste reduction plans to NEA.

sections.label: Extending mandatory waste reporting
sections.summary: From 2020, the mandatory waste reporting scheme will be extended to other large waste generators.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: From 2020, we will extend the mandatory waste reporting scheme to other large waste generators.

sections.label: Disposables ban for new stallholders
sections.summary: Since September last year, disposables are no longer permitted for dine-in when new cooked food stallholders operate at existing NEA-managed centres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Since September last year, disposables are also no longer permitted for dine-in when new cooked food stallholders operate at existing NEA-managed centres, that means for new stallholders, new tenancies.

sections.label: IAS services at cemeteries
sections.summary: IAS services are on track to be available at Choa Chu Kang Cemetery by 2020 and Mandai Crematorium and Columbarium Complex by 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: IAS services are on track to be available at Choa Chu Kang Cemetery by 2020 and Mandai Crematorium and Columbarium Complex by 2021.

sections.label: Replacing quartz plaques with marble
sections.summary: The contractor has undertaken remedial measures to replace the quartz plaques with new marble ones and will bear all additional costs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The contractor has undertaken remedial measures to replace the quartz plaques with new marble ones and will be bearing all additional costs incurred.

sections.label: Incubation stall programme update
sections.summary: Six new stallholders will join NEA's ISP, bringing total incubation stalls to 10, and NEA has extended the six-month tenure at 50% discount to nine months.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Mr Gan Thiam Poh asked for an update on ISP.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I am pleased that six new stallholders will be joining NEA's ISP, bringing the total number of incubation stalls in operation to 10.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To provide greater support for them, NEA has extended the six-month tenure at 50% discount off rental rates to nine months.

sections.label: CDW subsidies and hawker centres
sections.summary: Additional two years of stepped-down CDW subsidies, 20 new hawker centres by 2027, and the Bukit Batok Hawker Centre site are announced.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To help them, as well as encourage more centres to take up CDW, I am pleased to announce that we will provide an additional two years of subsidies at a stepped down rate of 50% and 30% in the third and fourth year respectively.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To ensure Singaporeans have continued access to affordable food at hawker centres, we are building 20 new hawker centres by 2027.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I am pleased to announce the site of the Bukit Batok Hawker Centre.

sections.label: Agri-food industry visioning exercise
sections.summary: A visioning exercise with stakeholders in the coming months will co-create the future of the agri-food industry.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To further develop our agri-food industry, we need to transform it.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will be reaching out to stakeholders in a visioning exercise in the coming months to co-create the future of the agri-food industry together.

sections.label: Waste Master Plan consultations
sections.summary: Online consultations on the Master Plan have launched, with focus group discussions in April with Zero Waste SG and LepakInSG.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Waste and resource management are issues which will impact everyone, and your views matter.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have just launched our online consultations on the Master Plan.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will jointly organise focus group discussions in April with Zero Waste SG and LepakInSG.

sections.label: Reducing blue bin contamination
sections.summary: 40% of blue bin contents cannot be recycled or are contaminated with food waste, with an aim to reduce this to 30%, 20% or 10%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Today, 40% of what is placed in our blue bins cannot be recycled or are contaminated with food waste.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Let us aim to reduce this to 30%, 20% or even 10%.

sections.label: PUB default notice to Tuaspring
sections.summary: PUB issued a default notice to Tuaspring Private Limited, a Hyflux subsidiary, for failing to keep the plant reliably operational.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Two days ago, PUB issued a default notice to Tuaspring Private Limited, a subsidiary of Hyflux, for being unable to fulfil contractual obligations, in particular, failing to keep the plant reliably operational.

sections.label: Default notice and water security
sections.summary: Concerns over Tuaspring's operational viability and finances led to a default notice to preserve water security.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As Minister Ong Ye Kung mentioned in his reply to a PQ recently, the financial performance of a company depends on many factors, such as the global business conditions, competition, performance of specific projects and also its own business decisions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But we are privy to how it is performing in the plant, which is that we are worried about its operational viability, and we also know that it does not have the financial ability to finance six months of its operation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Therefore, those are among the factors which, flagged out, are worries for us, that it will not be tenable for TPL to continue its obligation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Therefore, we have served the default notice in order to preserve our water security.

sections.label: CDW adoption subsidy extension
sections.summary: Subsidies for adopting CDW in existing hawker centres are extended by two years at 50% and 30%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, earlier, I just announced that we will be extending the subsidies for adopting CDW in the existing hawker centres by another two years, of 50% and 30%.

sections.label: Confirmed IAS sites
sections.summary: The two IAS sites, Choa Chu Kang and the Mandai Columbarium and Complex, are confirmed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For the two IAS sites – Choa Chu Kang as well as the Mandai Columbarium and Complex – they are confirmed.

sections.label: Toxic drugs disposal
sections.summary: Toxic drugs must be disposed of by specialised industrial waste collectors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Regarding the drugs, if they are toxic, they will have to be disposed of by the specialised industrial waste collectors.

sections.label: Diesel vehicle switch outcomes
sections.summary: From 2013 to 2018, 40,000 diesel vehicles switched to cleaner vehicles, and diesel taxis fell from 86% to 73%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The outcome of this slew of measures for the last few years is, I would like to report, for example, from 2013 to 2018, 40,000 diesel vehicles or about 26% of commercial goods and buses have actually switched to these cleaner vehicles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The proportion of diesel taxis decreased from 86% in 2016 to 73% in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In fact, zero new diesel taxis were registered in 2018.

sections.label: Climate action and zero emission
sections.summary: The Government will adopt zero-emission heavy vehicles when viable, and measures aim to cut greenhouse gas emissions by 36% by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Once a more viable vehicle type that can go towards zero emission or when totally zero emission for the heavy vehicles category is in the market and is accessible and affordable, we will go for it.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Chairman, I would like to ask the Minister to provide the response that I had suggested, that is, whether the Ministry will be considering a Climate Change Bill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have a Climate Action Plan, and this has been very comprehensive, looking at various sectors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The things that the Government must do, people must do, and legislation that contributes towards the climate action, including energy efficiency, through the Energy Conservation Act as well as the Carbon Tax Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: With the measures that we have put in place, we believe that we will be able, in the first instance, to meet our nationally determined contribution for reducing our greenhouse gas emissions by 36% by 2030 and then levelling after that.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: That is most important – getting the industries on board, at the same time, transforming them to be more energy-efficient and contribute towards the solution.

sections.label: Withdrawal of amendment
sections.summary: The speaker asks leave to withdraw his amendment.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Chairman, I beg leave to withdraw my amendment.
